title: 147873187 - 42-t-7585721-20060476F-001-006-2013
doc_notes: This is a GAO report investigating government records concerning the 1947 Roswell crash, which concludes that the recovered object was likely a Project Mogul balloon.

encounters.summary: The 509th Bomb Group and RAAF public information office reported the recovery of a 'flying disc' near Roswell, which was later identified by military officials as a radar-tracking balloon.
encounters.quote: The object turned out to be a radar tracking balloon.

encounters.summary: An Eighth Air Force official informed the FBI that a hexagonal-shaped disc suspended from a balloon by cable was recovered near Roswell and sent to Wright Field for examination.
encounters.quote: The disc is hexagonal in shape, and was suspended from a balloon by cable
